systems_description.unimem-full: unimem engine, agent-initiated recall (unimem_recall tool, k=5), graph expansion when the query looks multi-hop
systems_description.unimem-lite: same database with all graph edges deleted (anchors + scoring only)
systems_description.unimem-passive: unimem full with the passive (gateway-injected) gate enabled
systems_description.silo-per-harness: unimem full, but one store per harness: notes written in claude-code are invisible to codex and vice versa
systems_description.vector-top5: every write stored verbatim (no screening/dedupe/supersede), cosine top-5 over all notes, same embedder
systems_description.vector-top5-cwd: as vector-top5 but only notes written in the same directory (or home) are visible
systems_description.bm25-top5: every write stored verbatim, BM25 (k1=1.2,b=0.75, same tokenizer) top-5 over all notes
systems_description.bm25-top5-cwd: as bm25-top5 but only notes written in the same directory (or home) are visible

errors.content: 学院规定论文正文不能用 AI 生成或整段改写，只能用来查语法和修 LaTeX 报错。帮我改论文时只给修改建议，不要直接重写段落。
PR titles may be longer than commit subjects, up to 80 characters, and end with the ticket key in brackets, e.g. `[TT-42]`.
论文最终提交用 `make submit` 打包，会自动加封面、原创性声明和授权书，生成 submit/ 下的 PDF。
